James purchased a number of reams of copy paper for his office at a cost of $\$x + 10\%$ Goods and Services tax, for each ream.

If he didn't have to pay the tax, he could have purchased another 5 reams of the same paper for the same amount of money.

The cost of $N$ reams with tax is $N(1.10x)$. Without tax the same money buys $N + 5$ reams at $\$x$ each, so

$$\begin{aligned} N(1.10x) &= (N + 5)x \\ 1.1N &= N + 5 \\ 0.1N &= 5 \\ N &= 50 \end{aligned}$$
